fusions.name: Draw the Venom
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 30% health for 18 damage and draws out every affliction you have on it: 1.5 times their remaining damage is added to the blow and they are used up.

fusions.name: No Known Remedy
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Snake-Eater's Blood
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Better Out Than In
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
